name: Adaptively Placed Multi-Grid Scene Representation Network (APMGSRN)
definition: An SRN architecture that uses multiple spatially adaptive feature grids to dynamically allocate neural network resources to regions of high error in a volume, avoiding expensive octree refining/pruning/traversal.
summary: APMGSRN is a scene representation network that uses learnable transformation matrices to adaptively position feature grids, avoiding expensive octree structures while maintaining high accuracy for sparse volumetric data.
